[[File:Creature_attacks_mimphs_1.png|thumb|right|The creature]]
At least one member of a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Hair/Legends|furred]], bipedal creatures with [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Mouth/Legends|tongues]] lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The creatures had sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. One of them attacked a group of [[mimph]]s and tried to [[Diet/Legends|eat]] them before the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] swooped down on a [[Hang-glider/Legends|skin glider]] and rescued the mimphs.

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This creature appears in the opening credits of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated cartoon series. The beast does not reappear in any of the episodes of the series, however.
